title: Bounded global explicit-public project publication read
purpose: Introduce the smallest persistence capability needed for a future anonymous Sesh discovery surface without querying or exposing private project presentation state.
queryContract: Order by updated_at DESC then project_id ASC.
Never return more records than the validated limit.
validation: Validate every persisted publication record through the canonical publication validator.
Fail closed if any returned record is not public.
Fail closed if the provider returns more records than requested.
privacyBoundary: Private publication records must never be returned by this capability.
This capability does not provide a private-project existence oracle.
ownerCreatorId remains internal persistence data for downstream invariant checks and is not approved as public presentation output.
No PrincipalId, account identity, session identity, CRM identity, or legal identity is introduced.
scope: No public audio or media delivery.
rightsBoundary: Explicit public presentation state does not grant copyright, master, composition, publishing, distribution, label, management, royalty, licensing, revenue, collaborator, legal, CRM, account, or identity rights.
next: Compose this bounded persistence capability with canonical project and creator presentation checks before exposing any discovery page or API.
